# TomTom Adventures Flaming Special Archipelago
### What Now?
Yeah, you haven't heard of this game. That's because I made it myself in 2017 as one of the many game side projects I had throughout high school. It's not a great game by any means but I have fond memories of it and decided to use it as a way to get into APWorld developing. Please give it a try if you want a small and easy game to add to your list of playable AP games :)

### How do I install this?
Refer to the [setup guide](https://github.com/Awesome7285/TomTom4AP/blob/main/docs/setup_en.md) for instructions on installing and connecting to a multiworld.

### Plans for the future
- Deathlink
- Other power-ups randomized
- Roomsanity (every individual room is a check)
- Other fillers or potentially traps
- Poptracker?

Is the client stable enough? We'll find out I guess. First non pre-release.
Setup Instructions:

1. Open the "TomTom 4 Client" from Archipelago Launcher.
2. The client should prompt you for a file executable. This file is your game exe, it should be titled "TomTomAdventures4AP.exe". Navigate to it and select it. The client should then open the game for you.
3. Connect to the Archipelago server and enter your slot name.
4. After connecting, start playing!
Note: After selecting the directory for your game executable, the client stores this directory in a file in your Archipelago's install titled ".tomtom4_client_config.json". The client will only prompt you once for the game directory after each new version. If you reinstall the game or happen to move it elsewhere, you should delete the config file so the client re-prompts you for the game directory.
